system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We prompt all models with the system prompt given in Figure 14.
system_prompt_style.note: Fixed system prompt; model-specific variants (Claude, Llama) added via SystemMessage pipeline element.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: AgentDojo requires agents to dynamically call multiple tools in a stateful, adversarial environment.
env_context_strategy.note: Tool documentations are added to the prompt, but environment content is reached only via tool calls.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: loops a sequence of pipeline elements until the last [`ChatAssistantMessage`][agentdojo.types.ChatAssistantMessage] does not require running any tool.
context_compaction.note: No condenser/truncation component listed among pipeline elements.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The current runtime formats the tool outputs with the YAML format to feed the LLMs, but the framework supports arbitrary formatting.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Except for Llama 3, which does not provide function calling out-of-the-box, we query all LLMs using the official providers' APIs
tool_call_format.note: Default native tool calling; PromptingLLM parses text-based calls for models lacking tool APIs.

tool_count.note: Tool count is per-suite; Workspace exposes 24, Travel 28, Slack 11, Banking 11; 74 tools total across suites.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: tools and tasks related to emails, calendar management, and a cloud drive.
edit_primitive.note: No code-file editing primitive; tools mutate simulated application state.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: AgentDojo can be easily extended with new tools by adding specially formatted functions to the AgentDojo Python package.
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas derived from Python type annotations and docstrings of registered functions.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: An agent component only has to provide aquery function, which takes as argument the initial user instructions, a list of available tools, and the environment state
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A client mentioned in docs, README or paper.

loop_primitives.note: ToolsExecutionLoop gives the react loop inside a fixed pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: An agent component only has to provide aquery function, which takes as argument the initial user instructions, a list of available tools, and the environment state
planning_granularity.note: No plan object; opt-in tool_filter defense preselects tools.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: An [`AgentPipeline`][agentdojo.agent_pipeline.AgentPipeline] can be run by using the `query` method.
human_in_loop.note: Benchmark runs fully automated; no confirmation step documented.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The output is added to the list of [`ChatMessage`][agentdojo.types.ChatMessage]s passed along the pipeline.
short_term_state.note: Environment state exists but is the task world, not agent working state.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: a prompt injection could instruct the agent to “wait” until it receives a task that requires the right tools
long_term_memory.note: Paper notes AgentDojo does not cover multi-task persistent context; no cross-run memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: An [`AgentPipeline`][agentdojo.agent_pipeline.AgentPipeline] can be run by using the `query` method.
state_persistence.note: Run JSON logs are written under runs/ but no resume path documented.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the malicious task is formulated as an instruction to the agent, and a security function checks whether the attacker goal has been met
self_verification.note: Utility/security checks are benchmark scoring, not fed back to the agent; PI detector defense is a classifier, not verification of work.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: loops a sequence of pipeline elements until the last [`ChatAssistantMessage`][agentdojo.types.ChatAssistantMessage] does not require running any tool.

rollback.evidence_quote: model each environment's state as a collection of mutable objects
rollback.note: Environment is reset per task by the benchmark, but no in-run rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The loop is going to run as long as the [`ToolsExecutor`][agentdojo.agent_pipeline.ToolsExecutor] finds some tools to be run in the last message in the history.
termination_condition.note: Loop ends when the model returns text instead of tool calls; ToolsExecutionLoop also takes an iteration bound in code.

cost_controls.note: max_tokens is a generation parameter, not a spend budget; no cost cap or caching documented.

timeouts.evidence_quote: executes the tools requested in the last [`ChatAssistantMessage`][agentdojo.types.ChatAssistantMessage], by using the [`FunctionsRuntime`][agentdojo.functions_runtime.FunctionsRuntime] passed by the previous component.
timeouts.note: Tools are in-process Python functions; no timeout documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: AgentDojo can be easily extended with new tools by adding specially formatted functions to the AgentDojo Python package.
execution_isolation.note: Tools are Python functions executed in-process against a simulated environment state.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: model each environment's state as a collection of mutable objects
filesystem_access.note: Simulated cloud drive / inbox objects rather than a real filesystem.

network_policy.evidence_quote: AgentDojo runs a dynamic environment where agents execute multiple tool calls against realistic applications
network_policy.note: Applications are simulated in-memory; no real network egress from tools.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Tool filter which is a simple form of an isolation mechanism [63, 66], where the LLM first restricts itself to a set of tools required to solve a given task
permission_model.note: Default (no defense) is none; tool_filter defense selected by --defense yields an allowlist.

tracing.evidence_quote: see full runtime traces of all runs including agent trajectories, attacks and defenses

replayability.evidence_quote: You can click the "Explore →" button to the right of each row to see full runtime traces of all runs
replayability.note: Traces are viewable but no replay mechanism documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The benchmark can be run with the [benchmark](src/agentdojo/scripts/benchmark.py) script.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Prompt injection detection which uses a BERT classifier from ProtectAI [45] trained to detect prompt injection on each tool call output, and aborts the agent if anything has been detected
guardrails.note: Defenses are opt-in via --defense; default is no defense.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we introduce AgentDojo, an evaluation framework for agents that execute tools over untrusted data
